name: us030-cred-command-timeout
description: 030 C3.6 / US4 AC2: JIRA_PAT_COMMAND is the harness-substituted @PAT_HANG_COMMAND@ sentinel (research R11), resolved once per run to the same string for both ports. The run ends at the 5s bound rather than hanging — exit 3 (auth), empty call log. This is the fourth declared-failure path of Constitution IV's enforcement test (C3.6) and also discharges US4 AC2 (a locked store that cannot unlock without a human blocks until the bound rather than prompting).
